subtitle: Kiln yoga & rest, offline
promotional_text: Fire yoga, breath, and sleep in this phone, plus a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
description: Lichen Kiln is a personal wellness learning system that teaches yoga, breathing, mindfulness, meditation, relaxation, flexibility, and steady daily routines - privately, on your device. After you install the app, it keeps working with Airplane Mode on. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. It is not just a meditation timer. You get a kiln of practice you can sit with without a subscription or a signal: personalized sessions, breathing, sleep, and a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud. Kiln is an on-device teacher that picks a session from your glaze, minutes, bisque, hour, and recent practice. Timed yoga and mobility sequences come with teaching cues. Breath vents use two rising bars. Night practices are written for bed. Pose shelf offers short lessons. Folio is a private journal — fully offline. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Sessions ship inside the app. Journal, preferences, and logs live in local storage.
app_review_notes: Lichen Kiln is a complete offline yoga and meditation teacher. Complete onboarding, fire Hearth’s session, run Four vents (kiln-vent breath), open Batch, and save a Folio note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
